title: Brain envelope (compiled brain)
description: The top-level compiled-brain document (app/brain.json / D1 export). READ-ONLY: emitted by scripts/gen-brain.py (single repo) or scripts/aggregate-brains.py (metarepo). `meta` self-describes the format — meta.version is the authoritative schema version a stale brain is migrated against (scripts/migrate-brain.py, #25). meta is OPTIONAL so a brand-new or hand-aggregated brain without a header still validates; nodes/edges $ref the per-record schemas.

x-conflict.readonly_reason: compiled artifact — author the source, recompile the brain
